Chanakya University vs Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College for BBA is a private university compared with a Bengaluru college. Chanakya has the official fee on this page. Jain College has the only placement record, from 2025.

sections.heading: Chanakya University vs Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jain College if you want the only placement record on this page, from 2025, at an average of ₹4.92 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh. This page has no fee row for the college, so confirm the official circular.

Choose Chanakya University if you want an official 2026-27 fee. The university lists BBA Honors tuition of ₹1.75 lakh a year, a first-year payable fee of ₹1.80 lakh including registration, and a four-year programme total of ₹7.05 lakh. This page has no Chanakya BBA placement row.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and what is missing
paragraphs: Chanakya University's official 2026-27 fee page lists BBA Honors tuition at ₹1.75 lakh a year. Registration of ₹5,000 brings the first-year payable amount to ₹1.80 lakh. The same table lists a four-year total programme fee of ₹7.05 lakh.
Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College has no BBA fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Get the college's current official notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jain College's recorded 2025 figures are an average package of ₹4.92 lakh and a highest package of ₹9 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise. Confirm that the official report is for the BBA programme.
Chanakya University has no BBA placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official undergraduate placement report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. BBA admissions may use Class 12 marks, CUET, or a university test.
Read the current official admissions page of each institute for eligibility and any entrance requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Chanakya University is listed at its Devanahalli / Brigade Orchards campus on the Bengaluru outskirts. Jain College is listed at V.V. Puram in the city.
If commute will decide the choice, visit both campuses and compare official fees, because one side has no fee row here.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2025 placement record on this page, Jain College is the side we can quote, but you must get its official fee.
If you want an official 2026-27 fee, Chanakya University is the side we can quote, at ₹1.75 lakh tuition a year and a ₹7.05 lakh four-year total, but you must ask for a placement report.
Do not invent a missing fee or a missing package.

faqs.question: Does Jain College have a recorded BBA fee on this page?
